cmd.xlsx.undo_apply: Undo the last XLSX spreadsheet apply
xlsx_undo.later: Not undone: the model was edited after this XLSX spreadsheet apply. Use Ctrl+Z step by step or the History panel.
xlsx_undo.gone: Nothing to undo: this XLSX spreadsheet apply is already undone.
xlsx_undo.busy: Finish or cancel the current drawing first, then undo the XLSX spreadsheet apply.
